question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and if so should it be a static artifact, a runtime-served endpoint, or an explicitly documented TypeBox/JSON Schema client-generation path?
rationale: The choice defines public API coverage, auth/scope visibility, plugin-route exposure, versioning, and upgrade compatibility, which automation should not choose from the current source layout alone.

options.title: Design the public schema contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, covered APIs, and security/versioning rules before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a release-attached or committed schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime endpoint yet.

options.title: Defer To Existing Protocol Docs
options.body: Close later only if maintainers decide the TypeBox/JSON Schema pipeline and Gateway protocol docs are the intended client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design the public schema contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose schema format, exposure path, covered APIs, and security/versioning rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal across Gateway HTTP routing, protocol generation, and external integration docs points to steipete.
